summary: The constant rename left two importers referring to a name that no longer exists.

findings.title: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT renamed but two importers still reference the old name
findings.body: The rename to `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` migrated `http.py` but `client.py` and `server.py` (both changed in this PR) still do `from aws_lambda_powertools.shared.constants import DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`, which now raises ImportError at import time. Fix: update both imports and both call sites to the new name.
